buyer.notes: BLP = logistics vertical of Bridge Investment Group (SEC 424B4 2021 names BLP strategy). Bridge Logistics Value strategy: 'acquiring and repositioning high-quality logistics real estate assets in supply-constrained U.S. infill and global gateway markets, emphasizing disciplined basis, off-market and selectively marketed opportunities' (GlobeNewswire 2026-06-02: Value Fund II closed at ~$1.4B vs $1B target). Four regional HQs: New Jersey, Los Angeles, Atlanta, Dallas (Connect CRE). NJ deals seen: Linden 3301 & 3351 Tremley Point Rd 2-building 170,000 SF on 14.65 ac, $89.5M (2022-07); Piscataway 250 Circle Dr N 59,572 SF + 0.8-ac yard, off-market core-plus, BLP's 21st deal (2022-07-18); Hasbrouck Heights 1-5 Plant Rd 202,000 SF + half-acre lot, off-market, $45M (2023-05). Not the same firm as call-list buyer Bridge Industrial. People: Will Gilkeson, Investment Officer - Northeast, East Rutherford NJ office (DC Velocity, Linden release); Greg Boler, Managing Director - Eastern region, hired from Transwestern to chase East Coast infill/gateway acquisitions from Georgia to New Jersey (Bisnow); Christopher Todd, Managing Director (Hasbrouck Heights). Team page: bridgeblp.com.
